notes: The %ctabler macro (unmodified body) transposes a single AHRF county-year variable into one row per county+metric with y22..y00 columns. Original reads from a 14,753-column AHRF fixed-width extract; here &ahrf_out points at a 5-county mock table (CA/NV) shaped like the real AHRF field-naming convention (F1121520 = 2020 value of field F11215, 'MDs Total Ptn Care Non-Fed'). Macro called once, matching one of the repo's own %ctabler invocations for that field.
